description: This file is a Makefile fragment for OpenWrt build system, defining download methods, version handling, and integrity checks for package sources.

methods.name: dl_method_git
methods.description: Determines download method based on URL for git repositories.

methods.name: dl_method
methods.description: Guesses download method from URL and protocol.

methods.name: dl_pack
methods.description: Creates compressed archive from checkout.

methods.name: dl_tar_pack
methods.description: Creates tarball from source directory.

methods.name: gen_sha256sum
methods.description: Generates SHA256 checksum for a file.

methods.name: check_download_integrity
methods.description: Checks integrity of downloaded files using hash.

methods.name: check_warn_nofix
methods.description: Logs warning messages without fix.

methods.name: check_warn
methods.description: Logs warning messages, with optional fix if FIXUP is enabled.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/unknown
methods.description: Placeholder for unknown download method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/default
methods.description: Default download method invoking download.pl script.

methods.name: wrap_mirror
methods.description: Wraps download with mirror support and hash verification.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/cvs
methods.description: Defines CVS checkout method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/svn
methods.description: Defines SVN checkout method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/git
methods.description: Defines Git checkout method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/github_archive
methods.description: Defines GitHub archive download method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/rawgit
methods.description: Defines raw Git checkout and archive generation.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/bzr
methods.description: Defines Bazaar checkout method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/hg
methods.description: Defines Mercurial checkout method.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/darcs
methods.description: Defines Darcs checkout method.

methods.description: Validation rule for CVS source version.

methods.description: Validation rule for SVN source version.

methods.description: Validation rule for Git source version.

methods.description: Validation rule for Bazaar source version.

methods.name: Validate/hg
methods.description: Validation rule for Mercurial source version.

methods.name: Validate/darcs
methods.description: Validation rule for Darcs source version.

methods.description: Default download parameters.

methods.description: Sets download parameters from package variables.
